clustering.note: the 120 unsteered trials are stochastic rollouts of 4 prompts; all intervals in the paper resample trials, not prompts

label_robustness.note: family-wise significance under the conditional null is bracketed by T = 7.9 and 8.5; two adversarial label flips leave `bored` at 16.2, still clear of it

lr_statistic.definition: 2 * (l1 - l0) where l0 and l1 are UNPENALISED log-likelihoods evaluated at ridge-penalised estimates (lambda = 1, intercept unpenalised); calibration is from the resampling distribution, not a nominal chi2_1

random_directions.construction: iid Gaussian in the residual basis, Gram-Schmidt projected orthogonal to all 50 emotion vectors, then rescaled to the mean norm of the emotion vectors
